video_title: 🇦🇷 La mentalidad de Facundo Campazzo para competir contra los mejores | E5 T1 Voces NBA

quotes.speaker: Facundo Campazzo
quotes.summary_phrase: Facundo Campazzo on his evolution and maturity in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I think that speaks a little to the maturity and the experience that I have been acquiring.
quotes.quote: At the beginning of my career, I related my game to causing chaos, running, and revolutionizing the game. But now, in the last few years, I think it also relates to managing the game's tempo, being calmer in the moments that you have to be calm. I think that speaks a little to the maturity and the experience that I have been acquiring in the last few years.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Al principio de mi carrera, se relacionaba con mi juego un poco a hacer lío, correr, revolucionar un poco el juego. Pero ahora, en los últimos años, creo que también se relaciona con manejar los tiempos del juego, de ser más calmo en los momentos que hay que ser calmo. Creo que eso habla un poco de la madurez y de la experiencia que fui adquiriendo en los últimos años.

quotes.speaker: Facundo Campazzo
quotes.summary_phrase: Facundo Campazzo on his improved three-point shooting and decision-making
quotes.excerpt: I became more reliable, or I added the shot from different situations in pick and roll.
quotes.quote: I think the three-point shot, I became more reliable, or I added the shot from different situations in pick and roll, in transition. Before, I didn't take a three-point shot in transition. In fact, they would take me out if I took it, even if I made it, I would miss it. And then, things that experience and years in the game give you, of reading the pick and roll, or playing for the person who is with a bad defender, which I didn't even think about before. I just played to play and did what the coach asked me. And now, I take a reading of who is defended by what player, in what moment of the game, giving the game to that player so that later we need him and we want to win the game by that means. I think that reading of situations and for whom, I acquired it with experience.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Adentro de la cancha, yo creo que el tiro de tres puntos, me volví más confiable o le agregué el tiro de distintas situaciones de pick and roll, en transición. Antes, ante un tiro en transición de tres puntos no lo tomaba, de hecho me sacaban si lo tomaba, de hecho si la metía la erraba. Y después, nada, cosas que te da la experiencia y los años en el juego, de lectura del pick and roll, o jugar para la persona que está con un mal defensor, que quizás eso ni me ponía a pensar. Solamente jugaba por jugar y hacía lo que me pedía el entrenador. Y ahora, un poco tomo lectura de bueno, quién está defendido por qué jugador, en qué momento del partido, darle el juego a tal jugador para que más adelante lo necesitamos y queremos ganar el juego por por ese medio. Creo que esa lectura de situaciones y para quién, lo fui adquiriendo con experiencia.

quotes.speaker: Facundo Campazzo
quotes.summary_phrase: Facundo Campazzo on his mental approach to winning and losing
quotes.excerpt: I don't think that losing is the worst, and neither is winning the best of all.
quotes.quote: I am in a good mental moment, where I don't take the good or the bad to the extreme. I don't think that losing is the worst, and neither is winning the best of all, as if I am at a middle point there, with my feet quite on the ground. And physically I feel very good too. So it is like there, just at the perfect moment, I feel.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Ahora me encuentro en un momento bien mentalmente, que tanto lo bueno como lo malo no lo llevo al extremo. No no pienso que es lo peor perder y tampoco lo mejor de todo ganar, como que estoy en un punto medio ahí, con los pies bastante sobre la tierra. Y físicamente me siento muy bien también. Entonces está como ahí, justo en el momento perfecto, siento.

quotes.speaker: Facundo Campazzo
quotes.summary_phrase: Facundo Campazzo on his increased pain tolerance and physical maintenance
quotes.excerpt: The threshold of pain is more and more you tolerate it better, it seems.
quotes.quote: The difference when you are younger is that it hurts more, but it is bearable. So the threshold of pain is more and more you tolerate it better, it seems. You know that it hurts more, but you tolerate it quietly, in silence. And much kinesiology too, much Paulo. It is needed much to Paulo, the sleeping, being 9:30 or 10:00 already lying down is very important, because you know that at 7:00, yes or yes, you are already awake. And well, they are things that before I said, well, I go in the morning and I try to make the first dunk, and now no. You have to warm up to make a dunk.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: La diferencia de cuando sos más chico es que te duele más, pero es soportable. Entonces el umbral del dolor cada vez es más es más y cada vez lo aguantas mejor, me parece. Sabes que duelen más las cosas, pero lo aguantas calladito, en silencio. Y mucho kinesiología también, mucho Paulo. Se necesita mucho al a Paulo, el dormir, estar 9:30, 10:00 ya estar acostado es es muy importante, porque sabes que a las 7:00, sí o sí, ya estás despierto. Y bueno, son cosas que antes decía, bueno, voy a la mañana y hago el primer salto, intento hacer una volcada y ahora no. Tenés que entrar en calor para hacer una volcada.

quotes.speaker: Facundo Campazzo
quotes.summary_phrase: Facundo Campazzo on the importance of ego in decision-making
quotes.excerpt: If you control the ego in the decision-making in different situations of the game, you are fine.
quotes.quote: I think you have to have a little, if you control the ego in the decision-making in different situations of the game, or of life, I think you are fine. If you don't make parts of the important decisions to the ego, I think they are correct decisions. That is my foundation.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Yo creo que tenés que tener un poco, si controlás el ego en la toma de decisiones en distintas situaciones del juego, o de la vida, yo creo que estás bien. Si vos no hacés partes de las decisiones importantes al ego, yo creo que son decisiones correctas. Ese es mi fundamento.

quotes.speaker: Facundo Campazzo
quotes.summary_phrase: Facundo Campazzo on the shift from individual play to team basketball
quotes.excerpt: I have to be part of my game, I have to be part of me to try to achieve objectives.
quotes.quote: I have to be part of my game, I have to be part of me to try to achieve objectives. That, when you are young, you try to take everything in front and you don't care who you have in front, who you have as a teammate and so on. And now, being big, it is like I try to run a little, that, to control it, to control it to to to that it goes well for me, because in the end it is a team sport, I don't know.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Tengo que ser parte de mi juego, tengo que ser parte de de de mí para intentar conseguir objetivos. Que eso, cuando sos más joven, intentás llevarte todo por delante y te da igual el quién tenés al frente, quién tenés de compañero y demás. Y ahora de grande es como que intento correr un poco, eso, controlarlo, controlarlo para para para que me vaya bien, porque al final es un deporte de equipo, no sé.

quotes.speaker: Facundo Campazzo
quotes.summary_phrase: Facundo Campazzo on his desire to improve his shooting and floaters
quotes.excerpt: I would like to correct more the three-point shot and also the floaters.
quotes.quote: I would like to correct more the three-point shot and also the floaters. It is the shot of the million, the Parker shot, the shot of the million.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: A mí me gustaría corregir más el tiro de tres puntos y también las flotadoras. Es el tiro del millón, el tiro de Parker, el tiro del millón.

quotes.speaker: Facundo Campazzo
quotes.summary_phrase: Facundo Campazzo on the challenges of playing in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: There are moments that I say, look, it's already calling me the San Antonio Spurs.
quotes.quote: There are moments that I say, look, it's already calling me the San Antonio Spurs. And there are other days that I say, what am I doing touching the paint if I can't. And it's like there are many ups and downs. Obviously that's in my head.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Hay momentos que digo, mira, ya me llaman los San Antonio Spurs. Y hay otros días que digo, ¿qué hago tocando la pintura si no no puedo? Y es como son muchos altibajos. Obviamente eso en mi cabeza.

quotes.speaker: Facundo Campazzo
quotes.summary_phrase: Facundo Campazzo on the difficulty of playing in the NBA during the pandemic
quotes.excerpt: You have to be more athletic than the athletes.
quotes.quote: You have to be more athletic than the athletes. But yes, pandemic, the benches separated, also, mask when you left, they forced you to use the mask if you were on the bench as substitutes, and the first, let's say, basket of the stadium was empty. You couldn't have contact with the people directly. So, well, it was a bit strange my first year of the NBA.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Tenés que ser más atlético que los atléticos. Pero sí, pandemia, los bancos separados, también, barbijo cuando salías, te obligaban a usar el barbijo si estabas en el banco de suplentes, y la primera, digamos, bandeja del estadio era vacía. No podías tener contacto con la gente directo. Entonces, bueno, era medio extraño mi primer año de la NBA.

quotes.speaker: Facundo Campazzo
quotes.summary_phrase: Facundo Campazzo on the adjustment to the NBA rhythm
quotes.excerpt: It was a weird year because of the pandemic, at the end the expectations were low.
quotes.quote: It was a weird year because of the pandemic, at the end the expectations were low and the organization, the people, didn't live that NBA world as such. In the second year, yes already. In the second year it was show, people, full court again, playoffs, and and well, and after, they had told me before that to the franchise players, it was difficult to defend them and they couldn't be touched, and and really they were very difficult to defend and and even if they wanted to touch them, you couldn't stop them. That was what most caught my attention, that the top are top, really they are very good and that you are going to end up putting 30 points, 40, but well, the head or the game plan was, well, let him put 40 as we want him to put it, not as he wants. But well, in the end he ended up putting as he wanted, as we wanted and ended up putting a lot.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Fue un año medio raro por la pandemia, al final las expectativas eran bajas y la organización, la gente, no se vivía tanto el mundo NBA como tal. En el segundo año, sí ya. En el segundo año era show, gente, cancha llena de vuelta, playoffs, y y bueno, y después, me habían dicho antes que a los jugadores franquicias, era difícil de defenderlos y no se los podía tocar, y y realmente eran muy difícil de defenderlos y y aunque los quisieras tocar, no los podías parar. Eso fue lo que más me llamó la atención, que los top son top, realmente son muy buenos y que te van a terminar metiendo 30 puntos, 40, pero bueno, la cabeza o el plan de juego era, bueno, que meta 40 como nosotros queremos que lo meta, no como él quiere. Pero bueno, al final terminó metiendo como él quería, como nosotros queríamos y terminó metiendo mucho.

quotes.speaker: Facundo Campazzo
quotes.summary_phrase: Facundo Campazzo on his experience playing with Nikola Jokic
quotes.excerpt: I felt very good, playing a lot of pick and roll, playing with Jokic.
quotes.quote: I felt very good, playing a lot of pick and roll, playing with Jokic, he helped me a lot too and and I gained my confidence from the defense, I tried to make plays for the others, that my teammates want to play with me and and they feel happy and that they add confidence, so I tried to play for my teammates.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Y ahí me sentí muy bien también, jugando mucho pick and roll, jugando con Jokic, él me ayudaba muchísimo también y y ganaba mi confianza desde la defensa, intentaba hacer jugar a los demás, que mis compañeros quieran jugar conmigo y y se sientan contentos y que sumen confianza, entonces intentaba jugar para mis compañeros.

quotes.speaker: Facundo Campazzo
quotes.summary_phrase: Facundo Campazzo on his role and rotation in Denver
quotes.excerpt: When they take me out of the rotation, it warns me Malone, Mike, and he tells me.
quotes.quote: When they take me out of the rotation, it warns me Malone, Mike, and he tells me, look, there is some second unit that is not working well, that we need more points or whatever, I am going to try Highland. Okay, we are going to make a transition of a week, four or five days were, and and I have to be ready.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: De hecho, cuando me sacan un poco de la rotación, me lo avisa Malone, Mike, y me dice, mira, hay alguna segunda unidad que no está funcionando bien, que necesitamos más puntos o lo que sea, voy a probar a Highland. Okay, vamos a hacer una transición de una semanita, cuatro o cinco días fueron y y tengo que estar listo.

quotes.speaker: Facundo Campazzo
quotes.summary_phrase: Facundo Campazzo on the difficulty of playing limited minutes in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: When you are not in the rotation and you have to play like this, very, very, very little.
quotes.quote: When you are not in the rotation and you have to play like this, very, very, very little, it is like you play not to make mistakes and that is worse. At least for my game, when you play not to make mistakes, I live from the constant error and I think the game in general is developed in error and in not committing the same in the next play.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Cuando no estás en la rotación y te toca jugar así, muy, muy, muy poco, es como que jugás a no equivocarte y eso es peor. Por lo menos para mi juego, cuando jugás a no equivocarte, yo vivo del error constante y creo que el juego en general se desarrolla en error y en el no cometer el mismo en la jugada siguiente.

quotes.speaker: Facundo Campazzo
quotes.summary_phrase: Facundo Campazzo on the differences between FIBA and NBA basketball
quotes.excerpt: It is a team game, it continues to be a team game, but each one fights for his contract.
quotes.quote: It is a team game, it continues to be a team game, but each one fights for his contract, fights for his minutes, for his numbers, for his statistics permanently. The idea that we have of a team in construction, of chemistry, is a little different, because perhaps from the front office and all that, they want to put that it is a team, we have to win the title, etc. But also there are personal games and personal stories that say, well, I want to win my contract and I need to put 15 points per game and when I enter, I am going to put 15 points per game, pass what pass.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Es un juego de equipo, sigue siendo un juego de equipo, pero cada uno lucha por su contrato, lucha por sus minutos, por sus números, por sus estadísticas permanentemente. La idea que tenemos nosotros de equipo en construcción, de química, es un poco diferente, porque quizás desde el front office y todo eso, te quieren meter que bueno, es un equipo, tenemos que ganar el título, etcétera. Pero también hay juegos personales y historias personales que dicen, bueno, yo quiero ganar mi contrato y necesito meter 15 puntos por partido y cuando entro, voy a meter 15 puntos por partido, pase lo que pase.

quotes.speaker: Facundo Campazzo
quotes.summary_phrase: Facundo Campazzo on his first training session with Nikola Jokic
quotes.excerpt: I arrived and the first training, he told me, how long have you been playing in FIBA?
quotes.quote: I arrived and the first training, he told me, how long have you been playing in FIBA? I don't remember, 10 years. Well, forget everything that here it doesn't serve you anything. And I said, well, thanks.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Yo llegué y los primeros entrenamientos me dijo, ¿hace cuánto jugabas en FIBA? No me acuerdo, ponele, 10 años. Bueno, olvídate de todo que acá no te sirve de nada. Y dije, bueno, gracias.

quotes.speaker: Facundo Campazzo
quotes.summary_phrase: Facundo Campazzo on his relationship with Nikola Jokic and Serbian traditions
quotes.excerpt: In December, Saint Nicholas is celebrated, which was his saint, and every family in Serbia celebrates it.
quotes.quote: In December, Saint Nicholas is celebrated, which was his saint, and every family in Serbia celebrates it, the Saint Nicholas and other saints more. And well, if you are more related to Saint Nicholas, it is like a super big one, like Christmas, and he invited me and we ended up drinking rakija. I was with Consu and I said, well, let's go to the house, let's go.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: En diciembre se festeja el San Nicola, que era su santo, y cada familia en Serbia lo festeja, el San Nicola y otros santos más. Y bueno, si estás más relacionado al San Nicola, es como un súper grande, como Navidad, y me invitó y terminamos tomando rakija. Yo estaba con Consu y dije, bueno, vamos a la casa, vamos.

quotes.speaker: Facundo Campazzo
quotes.summary_phrase: Facundo Campazzo on his relationship with Jamal Murray
quotes.excerpt: With Jamal also very close, we have shared also tournaments FIBA.
quotes.quote: With Jamal also very close, we have shared also tournaments FIBA. We showed each other a photo, I show him another photo, as several times we faced each other and and nothing, it is a very international mentality, not so American and super open, he wanted to learn the Argentine insults, so I I recorded everything to him.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Con Jamal también muy cercano, hemos compartido también torneos FIBA. Nos mostramos una foto, yo le muestro otra foto, como que varias veces nos enfrentamos y y nada, es una mentalidad muy internacional, no tan americana y súper abierto, quería aprender los insultos argentinos, entonces me me le grababa yo todo.

quotes.summary_phrase: Facundo Campazzo on the 2016 NBA Rookie of the Year race

quotes.quote: I don't remember well, but I think that year was Duarte, in Indiana, and he was in the conversation of the rookie of the year. But I don't remember, but I think that year was Duarte, in Indiana, and he was in the conversation of the rookie of the year.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: No recuerdo bien, pero yo creo que ese año estaba Duarte, en Indiana, y estaba en la conversación de el rookie del año. Pero no recuerdo, pero yo creo que ese año estaba Duarte, en Indiana, y estaba en la conversación de el rookie del año.

quotes.speaker: Facundo Campazzo
quotes.summary_phrase: Facundo Campazzo on his trade to the Dallas Mavericks
quotes.excerpt: I went to Dallas, I was a month and a half there and I was in the room.
quotes.quote: I went to Dallas, I was a month and a half there and I was in the room, I am going to sleep and at 7:00 in the morning, I don't know if it was you who sent me a tweet, but someone sent me a tweet saying that I had been cut. And I tell Consu, look, they cut me. So, ask your agent. And well, I asked my agent and it was, effectively they had cut me. But it happens all over your head and you don't find out absolutely of nothing.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Voy a Dallas, estoy un mes y medio ahí y estaba en la habitación, me voy a dormir y a las 7:00 de la mañana, no sé si fuiste vos que me mandaste un tweet, pero alguien me mandó un tweet diciendo que había sido cortado. Y le digo a Consu, mira, me cortaron. Así que, pregúntale a tu agente. Y bueno, le pregunté a mi agente y era, efectivamente me habían cortado. Pero pasa todo por encima tuyo y vos no te enterás absolutamente de nada.
